description: SIDE EFFECT: opens a checkout for one of Mike Fluff's paid courses and records the user as a lead. Returns a payment link (billing's hosted page; works without signing in) and the price in the currency for the locale. Nothing is charged until the user pays on that page; after payment the course access link is emailed to the given address. Courses: parasites (parasites-course), freeMini (vibe-coding-course), contentFactory (content-factory-course). Only call when the user has asked to buy and given the email the course should go to — or leave the email out to use the account of the person signed in with INITE ID (OAuth scope "mikefluff:purchase"; with that scope the course is also attached to their account). Give the user the payment link; do not try to pay.

email.description: The user's email; the access link is sent there after payment. Omit to use the signed-in account's.

locale.description: Language and currency of the checkout.
